name: Wise Counsel
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital importance of seeking wise counsel grounded in the fear of the LORD, which is the foundation of true knowledge and understanding. The godly person avoids ungodly advice and instead values instruction as essential to life and growth, holding fast to it diligently. When many counselors provide guidance, safety and stability are found, as opposed to falling into ruin when counsel is absent. Ultimately, God's Word serves as a lamp to direct our steps, guiding us in wisdom and discernment.
